messages.subject: Project Atlas - legal DD questionnaire and data room
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Please find our legal due diligence questionnaire (Project Atlas - DD Questionnaire). The priority areas for us are the leasehold property portfolio, the equipment supply contract, the EMI option position and the open HMRC VAT enquiry. Could you let us know when the data room will be populated and whether title certificates will be provided for each club?

Many thanks,
Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
